purpose: Test whether Issue #97's era dependence is materially attributable to using EFFR instead of a broader proxy monetary-policy stance measure during unconventional-policy periods.
hard_rules: Keep Issue #97 macro features, lags, six-month horizon and linear model forms unchanged.
Do not add nonlinear interactions, labor-market variables, FCPI, real yields, term premium or Treasury returns in A1.
Use exactly the same OOS forecast origins for EFFR and Proxy targets.
Do not select a different OOS start or subperiod split after viewing results.
Do not load Treasury, T-bill, equity, gold or portfolio outcomes.

data_sources.macro: Reuse Issue #97 frozen Fed IP and BLS CPI sources.
data_sources.effr: Reuse Issue #97 frozen Fed H.15 H15/H15/RIFSPFF_N.M.
data_sources.proxy: Reuse Issue #99 A0 canonical SF Fed Proxy Funds Rate monthly freeze through 2025-12.

exact_common_sample.rationale: Provides more than 13 years of pre-OOS Proxy history and leaves a fully observed six-month outcome through 2025-12.

estimation.coefficient_information_rule: At forecast origin m, train only on rows whose six-month outcome is fully known before m.

boundary_rationale: SF Fed documentation states the proxy mapping is nearly exact through December 2008 and diverges thereafter as broader policy tools affect financial conditions.

directional: tighten/ease direction accuracy excluding neutral realized outcomes

primary_comparison.question: Does M2 add more stable incremental information over M1 for Proxy stance than for EFFR stance on the same OOS months?
report: full common-sample M1/M2 metrics for both targets
M2-M1 deltas by target and subperiod

decision_rules.policy_measurement_explains_material_era: Proxy M2 improves both RMSE and MAE over Proxy M1 on the full common OOS sample and on the post-December-2008 sample, while the corresponding EFFR M2 result does not; directional diagnostics are not materially contradictory.
decision_rules.policy_measurement_matters_but_speed_sti: Proxy target shows a clearer or more favorable M2-vs-M1 pattern than EFFR in unconventional-policy periods, but full-sample or leave-one-subperiod-out evidence is not stable enough to call the measurement issue decisive.
decision_rules.effr_measurement_not_the_main_problem: M2 still fails to improve Proxy M1 on the primary continuous-error measures, especially post-December-2008, so replacing EFFR with broader policy stance does not solve Issue #97's instability.
decision_rules.inconclusive_proxy_rate_evidence: Source/sample limitations or conflicting diagnostics prevent a defensible classification.

continuation_rule.if_measurement_explains: Freeze A1 finding, then separately preregister a state-dependent/nonlinear reaction-function study.
continuation_rule.if_measurement_does_not_explain: Freeze A1 finding and move to a new nonlinear reaction-function hypothesis without opening Treasury transmission.

forbidden: adding unemployment or financial-conditions variables in A1
